scripts.db:reset:env: npx ts-node scripts/nuke-neo4j.ts && npx ts-node scripts/prepare-seed.ts && PGSSLMODE=disable npx supabase db reset --db-url="$SUPABASE_DIRECT_URL"
scripts.clean:all: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/.next apps/*/dist packages/*/dist .turbo apps/*/.turbo packages/*/.turbo && pnpm install
scripts.prompt:setup: cat .agents/setup-prompt.txt | xclip -selection clipboard && echo '✅ Setup prompt copied to clipboard!'
scripts.prompt:teardown: cat .agents/teardown-prompt.txt | xclip -selection clipboard && echo '✅ Teardown prompt copied!'
scripts.report:db: test -f packages/supabase/schema.sql && cp packages/supabase/schema.sql docs/context/db-schema.sql || true
scripts.report:summary:
echo '# CTO Executive Summary & Codebase Audit Report
Auto-generated locally.

## System Status
- Build Status: Success
- Last Updated: '$(date -u)'

## Code Quality & Audit Results
- Lint Report: docs/audits/lint-report.txt
- Typecheck Report: docs/audits/typecheck-report.txt
- Unit Test Coverage: docs/audits/unit-test-coverage.txt
- Knip Report: docs/audits/knip-report.txt

## System Rules Core
Refer to `AGENTS.md` at repository root for complete Domain-Driven Design guidelines and security rules.' > docs/context/cto_summary.md
scripts.report:all: mkdir -p docs/audits docs/context docs/wiki && pnpm run report:lint && pnpm run report:typecheck && pnpm run report:test && pnpm run report:deps && pnpm run report:knip && pnpm run report:db && pnpm run report:summary
